fusions.name: Stiff Edge
fusions.desc: Flicks a stiffened strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 slashing damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unfolded Sheet
fusions.desc: Fans your strands out into a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Longhand
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Small Print
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 4 seconds.
